fixtures.title: Fixture 01 — Admin Workspace
fixtures.author: Project synthetic fixture (user-supplied URL)

revision.reason: Figma Plugin API does not expose an immutable file revision; observation time is recorded instead.

evidence.statement: User supplied this existing synthetic baseline for bounded verification.

conditions: Preserve baseline; it does not substitute for a real-world public file.
Only metadata and aggregate results are included; project license remains undecided.

notes: Read original baseline without modifying or duplicating it.

unverified: Actual Figma Desktop plugin/local bridge lifecycle and transport remain untested.
Immutable source revision unavailable; observations are not a frozen-source benchmark.
No human-approved semantic boundary/spec-link ground truth or historical semantic algorithm evaluation.
Synthetic single-screen structure does not establish real-world file suitability or scale.

structuralEvidence.statement: Page inventory returned one page (0:1). Bounded top-level inventory returned Dashboard, Notes and Geometry edge-case frames.
Four scoped Plugin API analyses completed. The page scope contains 80 nodes including PAGE, three FRAMEs, 20 RECTANGLEs and 56 TEXT nodes; maximum depth 2.

observedFacts: The page has separate UI and explanatory-note frames; screenshots of both were reviewed.
The notes frame has three numbered sections covering search/filter, table rules and shared-control behavior.
qualitative.llmInterpretation: Useful same-page UI/spec association baseline, with deliberately clean spatial separation.
limitations: Synthetic authoring is unlike messy production-file evolution.

observedFacts: Dashboard screenshot shows navigation, title/action, search/filter controls, a member table and pagination.
qualitative.llmInterpretation: Search/filter state, table and toolbar admit several plausible frontend decompositions.
limitations: No developer study or human-approved component ground truth.

observedFacts: Dashboard has 55 direct children and no nested descendant beyond depth 1 within that frame.
The page has 48 strict spatial containment pairs without source ancestry.
qualitative.llmInterpretation: Several visual regions plausibly group siblings that the editing tree keeps flat.
limitations: Geometric disagreement does not establish exact semantic ownership; AABB geometry ignores clipping and occlusion.

observedFacts: Explanatory text is outside the UI frame; one section discusses behavior shared by controls.
qualitative.llmInterpretation: Shared filter/export/permission behavior suggests many-to-many associations.
limitations: Proposed spec links were not human-approved or scored; no semantic extraction accuracy measurement.

observedFacts: One administration screen shows a member table with four visible rows and pagination.
qualitative.llmInterpretation: The UI and rules resemble a frontend implementation task, but the small file is only a functional baseline.
limitations: Only one product screen, no real production provenance and no deep hierarchy.

totalNodeCount.reason: Analyzer reads one explicit scope at a time. One observed page has 80 nodes including PAGE, but no independently versioned whole-file/document-root traversal was performed.

pageNodeCounts.scope: Page 0:1; includes PAGE root at depth 0, 80 observed nodes; selected snapshot only.
pageNodeCounts.method: Complete bounded traversal of the sole observed page, including PAGE root; not extrapolated from frame counts.

nodeTypeDistribution.scope: Page 0:1; includes PAGE root at depth 0, 80 observed nodes; selected snapshot only.
nodeTypeDistribution.method: Count types in complete page traversal.

maximumTreeDepth.scope: Page 0:1; includes PAGE root at depth 0, 80 observed nodes; selected snapshot only.
maximumTreeDepth.method: Selected PAGE has depth 0; all descendants included.

averageTreeDepth.scope: Page 0:1; includes PAGE root at depth 0, 80 observed nodes; selected snapshot only.
averageTreeDepth.method: Sum depths divided by 80 nodes, including selected PAGE root.

containerTypeRatios.scope: Page 0:1; includes PAGE root at depth 0, 80 observed nodes; selected snapshot only.
containerTypeRatios.method: Each listed node-type count divided by 80; COMPONENT_SET is not counted as COMPONENT.

autoLayoutRatio.scope: Page 0:1; includes PAGE root at depth 0, 80 observed nodes; selected snapshot only.
autoLayoutRatio.method: 0 auto-layout nodes / 3 nodes exposing layoutMode; eligibility differs from total-node denominator.

textNodeCount.scope: Page 0:1; includes PAGE root at depth 0, 80 observed nodes; selected snapshot only.
textNodeCount.method: Type-only count; text contents not exported.

textNodeDensity.scope: Page 0:1; includes PAGE root at depth 0, 80 observed nodes; selected snapshot only.
textNodeDensity.method: 56 TEXT nodes / 80 total scope nodes. Page area density not measured: PAGE has no positive-area BBox. Per-frame area density remains in linked raw aggregate report.

identicalBBoxRatio.scope: Page 0:1; includes PAGE root at depth 0, 80 observed nodes; selected snapshot only.
identicalBBoxRatio.method: Count nodes participating in an exact equal-box pair / 79 nodes with valid bounds; pair count = 1.

nearIdenticalBBoxRatio.scope: Page 0:1; includes PAGE root at depth 0, 80 observed nodes; selected snapshot only.
nearIdenticalBBoxRatio.method: All four edges within 0.5 px; includes exact equality. Count participating nodes / 79; pair count = 1.

spatialOverlap.scope: Page 0:1; includes PAGE root at depth 0, 80 observed nodes; selected snapshot only.
spatialOverlap.method: Positive-area AABB intersections / 3081 possible pairs of 79 bounded nodes; clipping, silhouettes and occlusion not resolved.

spatialContainment.scope: Page 0:1; includes PAGE root at depth 0, 80 observed nodes; selected snapshot only.
spatialContainment.method: One-way tolerant containment (0.5 px) excluding mutually containing boxes; geometric relation only.

treeContainmentMismatch.scope: Page 0:1; includes PAGE root at depth 0, 80 observed nodes; selected snapshot only.
treeContainmentMismatch.method: 48/123 geometric containment pairs lack original ancestry; 1/76 valid direct-parent pairs fail containment. Neither quantity measures semantic accuracy.

selectionExtractionMs.scope: Roots 0:1, 1:2, 1:58, 1:75 measured independently; do not add overlapping scopes.
selectionExtractionMs.method: Single Date.now observation per selected root inside official Figma MCP runtime. Tool round trips are separate; not a Desktop performance baseline.

memoryBytes.reason: No portable Plugin API heap counter or external process peak instrumentation; record byte budgets are not memory usage.

networkTransferBytes.reason: Serialized UTF-8 record/report bytes were measured, but actual network/Figma internal loading bytes were not. See linked per-scope byte counts.

testPurposes: Retain the existing small functional baseline.
Exercise equal/near-equal BBoxes and source-tree/spatial disagreements.
Compare live Plugin API aggregates with independently generated synthetic regression cases.
accessConstraints: Figma MCP read-only page inventory succeeded. Desktop integration is not implied.
